1.o: Seasoned demon hunter and master of the occult John Constantine takes on a rising darkness as he fights to reclaim his soul.

2.o: Deep in the mountains of Pennsylvania, John is a small mining community's only defense against an ancient Welsh spirit. John finds a vital new ally in a mysterious woman named Zed.

3.o: John and Zed face down evil to save a woman and her family from sinister forces, forcing John to confront the darkness in his own life - and Papa Midnite.

4.o: Constantine's old friend Gary Lester unleashes a powerful demon in Atlanta.

5.o: Constantine forms an unholy alliance with Papa Midnite when a ritual turns deadly.

6.o: When a young boy is taken over by a malevolent spirit, John must put aside his misgivings over exorcising a child and convince the parents that their boy is not all that he seems.

7.o: Zed has a bizarre vision of snakes that leads her and John to a small town where a preacher has mysteriously gained the miraculous ability to heal his congregation.

8.o: When an ancient evil surfaces in Mexico, an old friend of John's ends for his help bringing him close to the source of The Rising Darkness.

9.o: In order to fend off a vicious attack, John summons a demon into himself. Chas, Zed and Anne Marie race against time to save John before it’s too late.

10.o: When thousands of people in New York slip into a mysterious coma, John must find the evil behind it and defeat it before it consumes the city.

11.o: John helps his old University friend Ritchie Simpson, whose students have found a way into an alternate dimension only to unleash a maniacal killer.

12.o: When John enlists an unwitting Manny to investigate an ancient evil that's resurfaced in a hospital, a health scare causes Zed to question the source of her visions.

13.o: John and Zed return to New Orleans when Detective Jim Corrigan asks for their help in the case of a missing girl. Papa Midnite takes steps toward exacting his revenge on John and the truth behind the Rising Darkness comes to light.

1.o: اختطفه أحد أمراء الحرب من الفايكنج بعد مقتل والده في المعركة، ويتبنى الشاب أوتريد أسلوب الحياة الإسكندنافي حتى تحل المأساة بعائلته الجديدة.

2.o: يقع أوتريد بين عمه الماكر ألفريك وأمير حرب الفايكنج عديمي الرحمة أوبا، ويهرب ويبحث عن ألفريد، الرجل الذي سيكون ملكًا.

3.o: يتحالف أوتريد مع ألفريد المتوج حديثًا، لكن التزامه تجاه الملك الناشئ يعرض علاقته مع بريدا للخطر.

4.o: يبقي الملك ألفريد أوتريد قريبًا من مسرحية تكتيكية، لكن أوتريد سرعان ما يدرك أنه قد تم خداعه. وفي الوقت نفسه، تلوح في الأفق معركة كبيرة على ويسيكس.

5.o: يتطوع آوتريد لمهاجمة السفن الدنماركية، لكنه يتحدى أوبا في هذه العملية حيث يهدد الدنماركيون  ويسيكس.

6.o: يقود أوتريد مجموعة مداهمة إلى كورنوال في مهمة من أجل الثروة والاستقلال ويجذب انتباه ملكة ساحرة جميلة.

7.o: نتيجة لأفعالهما في كورنوال، يواجه أوتريد وليوفريك مباراة الموت. الدنماركيون يشنون غزو ويسيكس.

8.o: يغادر الملك المتحد ألفريد وأوتريد غطاء الأهوار ويوجهان نداءً حاشدًا لجميع الجيوش الساكسونية.

1.o: أرسله ألفريد شمالًا لفدية الملك المستعبد جوثريد، ويطلب بوكا المساعدة من أوتريد، الذي يقدم ولاءً جديدًا في سعيه للانتقام.

2.o: تلعب حيل الأباتي إيدريد على ضعف جوثريد. يحشد أوتريد رجال كومبرالاند للتقدم نحو يوفيرويك، لكنه يواجه خيانة قاسية.

3.o: تبحث هيلد وراجنار عن أوتريد، الذي يضع خططًا للهروب. يتطلع ألفريد إلى مملكة ميرسيا، وتندلع الفوضى عندما ينهار تحالف جوثريد.

4.o: تم إرساله إلى نورثمبريا، يسير أوتريد على خط رفيع بين الولاء لألفريد ومساعدة عداء الدم الوحشي لراجنار مع كجارتان.

5.o: بعد موسم من السلام، يتلقى أوتريد دعوة باطنية لمتابعة مصيره. يقدم إريك طلبًا ماكرًا، ويتنقل بيوكا في الأمور المتعلقة بالقلب.

6.o: مع تعمق عدم ثقته في أوتريد، يرسل ألفريد إيثيلريد لإخراج إريك وسيغفريد من لندن، لكن اللورد الشاب يحمل طموحاته الخاصة.

7.o: يواجه إيثيلريد الإذلال بعد خطأه في لندن الذي دفع ألفريد إلى الزاوية. تحول ولائها، إيثيلفليد يناشد أوتريد بشدة.

8.o: يتحدى أودا ألفريد لإجبار الملك على الحرب. يتآمر أوتريد مع إريك لإنقاذ إيثيلفلاد، مما يفرض مواجهة مصيرية مع سيغفريد.

1.o: صحته متدهورة وخوفًا على إرثه، يرسل ألفريد أوتريد لمواجهة تهديد جديد: المحارب الدنماركي الشرس بلودهاير وساحرته، سكايد.

2.o: يقع أوتريد في مواجهة ألفريد ، ويهرب شمالا إلى شقيقه راجنار. عينه على العرش ، يبدأ أيثيلولد في تجميع تحالف لضرب ويسيكس.

3.o: يحاول Bloodhair و أيثيلولد إقناع  أوتريد بالتحالف ضد أالفريد. خوفًا على حياتها، تلجأ إيثيلفليد إلى الأب بيوكا للحصول على المساعدة.

4.o: يلفت أوتريد انتباهه إلى محنة إيثيلفيلد. ألفريد يجبر إدوارد على مواجهة واجبه. مسيرات راجنر العسكرية لكن الخونة يخرجون من الداخل.

5.o: وهناك خيانة قاتلة تهدد بانشقاق جيش راغنر. أوتريد يشكل خطة معركة ماكرة ويجد حليفا غير متوقع في إدوارد الشاب.

6.o: إدوارد يتخذ قرارا ملكيا. ألفرد يضع الخطط لحكم ابنه المستقبلي. يواجه إيثيلولد مهمة غادرة. اوهيتريد وبريدا يبحثان عن خادم.

7.o: رسالة من أوتريد ومكائد سكادي تستغل الانقسامات بين الدنماركيين. ألفريد يصارع مع مصير آثيلولد بسبب تدهور صحته.

8.o: قد يعود إلى ويسكس ليفي بوعده إلى بريدا. مع اقتراب الزواج الملكي، ينشر أثيلولد الخلاف من الظلال.

9.o: في نهاية أيامه، ألفريد يأخذ أوتريد في ثقته حول خططه لمستقبل إدوارد الغامض، ولكن ألزوت يرسم مسارا مختلفا.

10.o: مع اقتراب معركة الطقس مع الدنماركيين، يواجه إدوارد غير المختبر قرارات صعبة حول مصير أوتريد، ويسيكس — وإنجلترا.

1.o: ويتلقى أوتريد أنباء عن ضعف دفاعات بيبانبورج بسبب الهجمات الاسكتلندية ويعتزم الاستيلاء على حق مولده ، ولكن إدوارد يرفض المساعدة.

2.o: عندما يقترب أوتريد ورجاله من بيبانبورغ ، يعود الابن الضال ويتجار ببعض الحيل في جعبته. أخبار خيانة كنوت تصل إلى ويسيكس.

3.o: يعاني أوتريد من خسارة لا تطاق في هجومه على بيبانبورغ لكنه يأخذ بعض الأسرى القيمة خلال انسحابه جنوبا. إيثيلفليد يستعد للحرب.

4.o: على أمل أن تنضم إليه قوات إدوارد ، تحالف أيثيلفليد وأوتريد مع الويلزيين لمواجهة جيش كنوت المكون من ألف محارب في معركة تيتنهال.

5.o: يبقى أيثيلريد التائب على وشك الموت بينما يتنافس إيلدورمن للسيطرة على ميرسيا ويستخدم إدوارد ابنة أخته إيلفوين كورقة مساومة.

6.o: يلاحق إيردوولف ورجاله حفلة أوتريد وهي تهرب عبر ريف دمره المرض. تصاعد التوتر بين إدوارد والمرسيانيين.

7.o: يعاني أيلفوين من المرض الذي يجتاح الأرض. يقترح إدوارد طريقا غير متوقع إلى الأمام لميرسيا. تم تحرير بريدا من قبل قريب كنوت.

8.o: يستعد أوتريد على مضض لتولي السلطة في مرسيا لكنه يصوغ سرا خطة بديلة. ينضم الزفاف إلى الدنماركيين في مهاجمة الويلزية.

9.o: الدنماركيون تحت قيادة بريدا وسيغتريغر كيس وينشستر ، بتوجيه من الخائن إيردولف. نصب هيستن كمينا لحزب أوتريد وأسر أسرى قيمين.

10.o: يحاصر إدوارد وينشستر وهو ينتظر تعزيزات إيثيلفليد ، لكن أوتريد غير مقتنع بأن الفتح هو حقا الهدف النهائي لسيغريغر.

1.o: البشائر السيئة والغارات الحدودية تجعل أوتريد أكثر يقظة في موقعه الشمالي. يزور الملك سيغريغر شقيقه سيئ السمعة روجنفالدر.

2.o: خيانة في أوفيرويتش ترسل سيغريغر بحثا عن المساعدة ، بينما تتوسل أوتريد إلى إيثيلفليد للحصول على دعم عسكري لا تستطيع تقديمه. إدوارد يلتقي حليف جديد.

3.o: في أعقاب المعركة المأساوية لإيوفيرويتش ، يضطر سيغريغر إلى اتخاذ خيار مؤلم. يتعلم إدوارد عن مؤامرات إيثيلهيلم في مرسيا.

4.o: يتقدم المنافسون سرا للخلفاء المتنافسين عند وفاة حاكم مرسيان. تجد بريدا العزاء في إيمان سجينها الأب بيرليج.

5.o: نجحت حيلة إيثيلهيلم في إثارة توترات الحرب بين إدوارد وسيغتريغر ، لكن بلطجيته يرتكبون خطأ فادحا في مهاجمة الحج.

6.o: تسير قوات إدوارد وسيجتريجر نحو المعركة بينما يتسابق أوتريد للكشف عن حقيقة مكيدة إيثيلهيلم وتجنب حرب مدمرة.

7.o: يقدم إدوارد دورا لستيورا من شأنه أن يعيدها إلى السلطة. يلتقي إيثيلهيلم بعدو سكسوني. أوتريد لديه حساب طال انتظاره مع الزفاف.

8.o: عند معرفة موقع إيثيلهيلم ، يقترح أوتريد هجوما جريئا لإنقاذ إيلفوين واستعادة حقه الطبيعي-لكن إدوارد حذر.

9.o: يسير إدوارد بقواته شمالا بينما يجند أوتريد قوة صغيرة للتسلل إلى بيبانبورغ. الملك قسطنطين يصل للقاء عروسه الجديدة, ايلفوين.

10.o: تتلاقى الجيوش في مواجهة ملحمية أخيرة تحدد مصير حلم الملك لإنجلترا-وأمل أوتريد في تأمين مستقبل عائلته.

1.o: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.

2.o: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel continue to encourage Lucifer to go back to hell.

3.o: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help. Lucifer enlists Chloe to investigate the case, which leads to the world of big money sports and people who will literally kill to be number one.

4.o: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.

5.o: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer becomes intrigued by the danger of the situation and begs Chloe to get in on the case. Meanwhile, when Maze admits to Amenadiel that she wants to go back to hell, he sets his sights on Dr. Linda.

6.o: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder. However, when he discovers something was stolen during the crime that was very personal to him, he demands that Chloe let him rejoin the case.

7.o: In attempt to find the contents of his stolen container, Lucifer enlists the help of an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.

8.o: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects. Meanwhile, Malcolm confronts Chloe about the night he was shot, and Lucifer experiences his first bout of jealousy.

9.t: A Priest Walks Into a Bar
9.o: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center. Meanwhile, Malcolm manipulates a way to keep an eye on Dan.

10.o: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death. Meanwhile, Chloe's mom returns home, sending Chloe's life into upheaval, as Lucifer learns his own dysfunctional family isn't nearly as unique as he thought.

11.o: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim’s glitzy Los Angeles charity.

12.o: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame - with her body  twisted into the shape of a pentagram - the investigation leads Lucifer  and team into the world of Satanists, where they soon realize, evil  doesn't always live where we expect it to.

13.o: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.

1.o: Lucifer is distracted by his mother’s escape from hell, as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress. Meanwhile, Chloe’s faith in Lucifer is tested by the new medical examiner, Ella. Also, Amenadiel hopes to rein in Lucifer’s wild side, as they both deal with the absence of Maze.

2.t: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
2.o: When Lucifer’s mother, Charlotte, turns up at the scene of a grizzly murder pleading innocence, Lucifer is hesitant to believe her tale. Not wanting to leave her on her own, he instructs Maze to babysit her – and not to torture her, allowing him to investigate the case with Chloe.

3.o: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a gruesome murder after a video of the crime surfaces on social media. When a second video appears, they realize they have a serial killer on their hands. Meanwhile, Lucifer’s mom returns as Charlotte Richards. Also, Amenadiel, struggling with his loss of power, has an appointment with Linda.

4.o: After the bodies of two young L.A. transplants are found poisoned, Chloe and Lucifer hunt for the killer. Upon Maze convincing Chloe to go out for drinks, which the detective perceives as an act of friendship, but is actually part of a bet between Maze and Lucifer, the two make a shocking decision.

5.o: Lucifer is excited to investigate the murder of his favorite action movie hero, Wesley Cabot. Longtime rival Rolf Van Zandt initially is a suspect, but the investigation soon shifts. Meanwhile, Uriel shows up and Amenadiel is forced to come clean about his lost powers. Also, Lucifer and Uriel fight about Chloe and their mother.

6.o: Guilty and self-destructive, Lucifer clashes with Chloe during an investigation, leading her to team up with Dan instead. Meanwhile, Amenadiel bonds with Charlotte, and Maze takes Trixie trick-or-treating.

7.o: When the prisoner convicted of killing Chloe's father is murdered, new evidence suggests he was actually framed. Meanwhile, Maze tries to find a job and Lucifer shadows Dan in order to learn how to be "normal".

8.o: Lucifer links Azrael's stolen blade to a string of violent stabbings and enlists Ella's help in locating the sword.

9.o: Following the murder of the owner of the building in which Lux is located, Lucifer and Chloe search for the killer, while Lucifer also deals with the fact that the new owner wants to evict him and demolish the place. Lucifer goes to great lengths to protect his home, and is entirely shocked when Chloe is supportive of him. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel follow Charlotte around, as she comes up with a plan to upset Lucifer enough to want to leave earth and go back to Heaven.

10.o: Charlotte is determined to get Lucifer to leave Earth by turning Chloe against him. Meanwhile, Amenadiel has begun working as Charlotte's soldier, which makes Maze question his loyalty.

11.o: Lucifer and Chloe investigate the murder of two victims, who happen to be Lucifer's ex-flames.

12.o: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a mysterious masked killer who is poisoning college students.

13.o: Lucifer must find the antidote to the Professor's poison before it kills Chloe. He travels to hell to find the Professor's soul and get him to turn over the antidote. While he's there, he is forced to confront his guilt about Uriel's death. Mom heads to hell to get Lucifer back, but Lucifer still feels betrayed by his parents because of something he discovers.

14.o: Lucifer returns to the city with a new bride in tow, oblivious to the distress his absence has caused. Determined to restore his working relationship with Chloe, he inserts himself into the investigation of the murder of an up-and-coming band's lead singer.

15.o: When it is discovered that the flaming sword is the only hope for the family returning home safely, the pressure is on for Lucifer to control what he has never been able to control before – his emotions – in order to ignite it. Meanwhile, Chloe wants to air some emotions of her own, but when a therapist and head of admissions at a prestigious private school turns up dead, the team must get to the bottom of it.

16.o: When a grisly murder takes place at an insane asylum, the prime suspect calls himself God. After realizing that this man could actually be his father, Lucifer struggles with his feelings towards him and tries to find the truth, all while trying to discover who the real killer is.

17.o: When the man who had the final piece of the Flaming Sword is murdered and the piece goes missing, Mom joins Chloe and Lucifer on the case to track down the killer. But when Lucifer gets sidelined, Maze recruits him to help save Dr. Linda's endangered career and confronts him about the secrets he's been keeping.

18.t: The Good, the Bad and the Crispy
18.o: After Charlotte accidentally charbroils a man to death in self-defense, Lucifer must try and keep Chloe from figuring out the truth. Lucifer puts Maze in charge of finding Charlotte and Amenadiel, who have both gone missing in light of recent circumstances, while he finds a permanent solution for the ticking-time-bomb he calls Mom.

1.o: Lucifer enlists Chloe's help to determine why he woke up in the desert with his wings on his back again, which could be related to an active crime scene.

2.t: The One with the Baby Carrot
2.o: After Lucifer removes his wings yet again, Linda becomes concerned that he is too focused on tracking down the Sinnerman and neglecting his own well-being. Tensions continue to rise between Lucifer and Chloe, but they realize they must put their differences aside to solve a case in which Lucifer takes a sudden interest. Once Detective Pierce's past is revealed though, everyone realizes that the Sinnerman is much more dangerous than they thought.

3.o: After talking to Lucifer and Linda, Maze realizes that she is looking for more out of life and decides to head to Canada for a tricky case. Chloe however, becomes concerned when she feels that Maze is being deceived by a scheming conman. Upon further investigation, Lucifer and Chloe make a stunning realization when they find that their target may be much closer than they thought.

4.o: When a youth counselor is found murdered, Lucifer and Chloe venture into the world of high-end reform programs to find the killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel adjusts his lifestyle in an attempt to help Lucifer, and Chloe questions Lt. Pierce's feelings towards her.

5.o: When a food chemist is found dead, Lucifer and Chloe's investigation pits them against an unexpected face - criminal defense attorney Charlotte Richards. Everyone is caught off guard when they see her back in the precinct. As Lucifer tries to understand her return, he makes a shocking discovery that helps solve the case.

6.o: When Lucifer discovers Candy has gone missing, he hightails it to Las Vegas with Ella in tow. They work to find her, but interesting secrets could compromise the investigation. Meanwhile, Chloe is upset that Lucifer left on her birthday.

7.o: A reporter seeks revenge when he discovers Lucifer has been sleeping with his estranged wife; a serial killer from Lucifer's past resurfaces.

8.o: When a murder is connected to a celebrity dating app, Lucifer and Chloe question all they know about the world of social media in order to solve the case. Meanwhile, Ella tries to avoid Charlotte, and Amenadiel helps Linda deal with the death of her ex-husband.

9.o: Lucifer is worried when he realizes that recipients of his favors start to turn up dead. After he and Chloe investigate, they are finally brought face-to-face with the Sinnerman. Meanwhile, Detective Pierce returns to work after taking a bullet, Charlotte finds a new career and Amenadiel has a new love interest.

10.o: With the Sinnerman in custody, Lucifer is prepared to go to any length to get his devil face back. Meanwhile, Trixie is introduced to Charlotte and questions the relationship she has with her father.

11.o: In a flashback episode that takes place when Lucifer first came to LA, Amenadiel comes to retrieve his fallen brother, but is shocked when he is mugged. Amenadiel enlists Lucifer's help to track down the mugger and Lucifer, in turn, offers his assistance - but only in exchange for a favor. Meanwhile, Chloe and Dan - who are still married - investigate the murder of an MMA fighter, Aidan Scott, at the hands of the same killer who mugged Amenadiel.

12.o: After Lt. Pierce's true identity is revealed, Lucifer tries to figure out his motives. In order to earn Chloe's assistance in his investigation of Pierce, Lucifer goes above and beyond to help her solve the murder of a professional surfer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel deals with a personal health issue.

13.o: When an ecstasy cook-turned-chemistry-teacher is found murdered in a cozy Los Angeles suburb, Lucifer and Pierce must go undercover to help track down the killer. Meanwhile, Maze has a newfound attraction for someone that she used to despise and Charlotte has a revelation.

14.o: When Chloe and Lucifer's investigation into the murder of a diamond thief points to one of Ella's brothers as the main suspect, Ella is driven to prove her brother's innocence and recruits an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Linda is upset when Charlotte comes to her for help and Detective Pierce hashes out his issues with Amenadiel.

15.o: When a best-selling novelist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe discover that her books are based on real people from her past, and must infiltrate her high school reunion in order to catch her killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel and Linda struggle with making their relationship public.

16.o: When a murder investigation reveals the dark side of Hollywood, Chloe puts her life on the line to protect an innocent victim. Then, Lucifer comes up with a hell-raising scheme to help Cain, but when Amenadiel and Maze get involved, things don't quite go as planned.

17.o: When a superstar singer's life is threatened, the team is thrust into the world of big-ticket stadium shows, crazed fans and divas, giving Lucifer a run for his money. Meanwhile, Charlotte tries to help Linda and Maze repair their friendship.

18.o: As Chloe and Lucifer go on the hunt for a serial killer targeting couples in love, Pierce realizes the case is connected to a murder he previously solved...in 1958. Then, Lucifer becomes upset when Pierce has a change of heart about an important decision.

19.o: When Maze is the prime suspect in a murder, Lucifer and Chloe enter the world of bounty hunting to investigate. Maze decides she wants to go back to Hell, but after Lucifer refuses, she turns to Pierce for help. Meanwhile, Charlotte's sanity is questioned when she makes a big discovery and Chloe admits she's dating someone.

20.o: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a murder during which a witness claims a winged guardian angel saved her life, causing Lucifer to become paranoid about his own actions. Meanwhile, Pierce and Chloe's relationship takes an interesting turn and Lucifer discovers something that could change everything.

21.t: Anything Pierce Can Do I Can Do Better
21.o: When a prima ballerina is brutally murdered, Lucifer helps Chloe solve the case and attempts to keep her focus away from Pierce. Amenadiel begs Charlotte to help him with an important plan, and Maze remains devoted to a task from which Pierce asked her to back away. 5.o: Amenadiel helps Chloe investigate a nun's untimely demise. Meanwhile, Lucifer lends Dan a hand, and Linda reveals a painful part of her history.

11.o: Lucifer's father — you know, God — decides to experience life as a regular human. Meanwhile, a boxer dies under mysterious circumstances.

12.o: A straightforward prisoner transport job turns into an increasingly dangerous, yet oddly invigorating, odyssey for Dan.

13.o: Linda throws herself into a deeply personal mission. Maze unmasks a blast from the past. Amenadiel ponders a new job.

14.o: Lucifer angles to be his father's successor. Ella makes a painful confession. Chloe investigates a murder at an aquarium.

15.t: Is This Really How It's Going to End?!

6.o: Wanting to do well on his first day with the LAPD, Amenadiel crosses paths with a racist detective from his past. Also, Lucifer tries to bond with Rory.

7.o: Just as Eve and Maze's wedding day arrives, Eve's ex, Adam — yes, that Adam — shows up hoping to reconcile. Later, Ella delivers some distressing news.

8.t: Save the Devil, Save the World

9.o: Lucifer tries to enjoy what may be his last day on Earth, Dan's killer escapes from prison, and Chloe drops a serious bombshell.

10.o: Desperate to rescue Rory, Lucifer and Chloe confront her kidnapper with guns and wings blazing. Lucifer finally comes to terms with his purpose.

1.t: Marriage is Not the Happy Ending
1.o: Jin Joo and Ban Do met when they were 20 and got married when they were 24. 18 years later, Jin Joo is exhausted from taking care of their child alone, and Ban Do is exhausted from work. They can't understand one another and decide to get a divorce. On the day that they decide to end their 18 years of marriage, something strange happens to them.

2.t: Memories are Remembered at Your Convenience
2.o: Ban Do and Jin Joo return to the year they were 20. Unfortunately, they face the worst day of both their lives. They are both excited to return to their college years, but that excitement turns out to be temporary. They meet at an unexpected place only to be reminded of the events that occurred that day.

3.o: Jin Joo and Ban Do thought their return to 1999 was a miracle that was to last one night. Contrary to their belief, they woke up the next day still stuck in 1999. Ban Do, who believed that he was the only one to travel back in time, finds out that Jin Joo has also come with him. The two agree not to get involved with one another and live new lives.

4.o: Jin Joo and Ban Do's argument is heard throughout the campus as it was broadcasted in the school radio show. The students of the school begin their search to find the married couple. Meanwhile, Nam Gil saves Jin Joo from getting hurt, and Ban Do goes on his first date with his first love, Seo Young.

5.o: Ban Do starts to worry about Jin Joo as she becomes involved with Hyun Suk. Nam Gil keeps calling Jin Joo out. He uses the leg he hurt while saving her as an excuse to see her. Jin Joo bumps into Ban Do and Seo Young at an unexpected place.

6.t: You Shine The Brightest When You Are Yourself
6.o: It's festival day at Hankook University. Ban Do remembers the humiliation he suffered on this day. He does whatever he can in order to prevent history from repeating itself. Meanwhile, Jin Joo, who is enjoying herself at the festival, ends up entering the May Queen contest.

7.t: Honesty Lies Between The Truth And Lies
7.o: Jin Joo finds out the truth about Hyun Seok. She and Ban Do plan their revenge together. The day they will get their revenge is finally here. It is the night of the "Medical Student's Night". Jin Joo accompanies Hyun Seok as his date. When they go to get their revenge, something unforeseeable happens.

8.o: Seo Young runs away from home and goes to Ban Do. Ban Do is unsure of what to do. Eun Sook questions Jin Joo because she had been acting strangely for the past few days. Meanwhile, Sul suddenly takes a leave from school and disappears.

9.t: Those Times We Had Been In Love
9.o: After getting revenge on Hyun Seok, Ye Rim begins to hit on Ban Do. Ban Do hesitates as he's faced with a chance to change his life around. However, he keeps thinking about Jin Joo who seems sad. He decides to take Jin Joo and his friends on an impromptu backpacking trip. However, someone who wasn't invited decides to join their trip.

10.t: You Can’t Take Anything For Granted
10.o: Jin Joo, Ban Do and their friends enjoy their spontaneous trip. Nam Gil tries to spend as much time with Jin Joo as possible. Ban Do is bothered by Nam Gil's presence during their trip. He continues to bicker with Nam Gil throughout their trip. Meanwhile, Jin Joo looks sick after returning from the trip.

11.t: Knotted Hearts Grow When We Ignore And Neglect Them
11.o: The petition for the director of the university begins to gain momentum. As the campus is getting together to promote his resignation, Jin Joo worries about the director's son, Nam Gil. Ban Do tries to find out how he got to 1999 and how he can get back to 2017. After much research, he figures it out and runs to Jin Joo to tell her what he figured out.

12.o: Ban Do refuses to see Jin Joo after his accident. Ban Do tells Jin Joo to forget about going back to the present and continue living in the past with her family. Jae Woo works hard for his audition for nationals. He wants to give up but doesn't for the sake of Bo Reum. Meanwhile, Bo Reum sees his efforts and makes a decision.

1.o: يحلم "داي وونغ" بأن يصبح نجم أفلام حركة، فيهرب من جدّه، الذي يريده أن يلتحق بالجامعة، وينتهي به المطاف في معبد مظلم.

2.o: تسلب "مي هو" من "داي وونغ" قوّة البلّورة التي أعطته إيّاها، وتخبره "مي هو" بلا مبالاة أنّها لن تساعده لأنّه خانها.

3.o: يصرخ "داي وونغ" في وجه "هاي إن"، التي تعتقد أن "مي هو" هي حبيبته، فيما تُفاجأ "مي هو" حين تسمع من "بيونغ سو" أنّ "داي وونغ" معجب بـ"هاي إن".

4.o: تفقد "مي هو" قوّتها تدريجيًّا مع ابتعاد "داي وونغ" عنها ومعه البلّورة، مُحاولة ألّا تبكي، ولكنّها تتحوّل إلى ثعلب.

5.o: يذهب "داي وونغ" للبحث عن "مي هو" ولكنّه لا يستطيع العثور عليها في أيّ مكان، وسرعان ما تغمره البهجة لرحيلها فيسعد بحريّته.

6.o: يُبرم "داي وونغ" و"مي هو" عقدًا على أن يصبحا حبيبين لمدّة 100 يوم، ويلاحظ "داي يونغ" أنّها تريد الزواج منه فيطلب منها التوقّف عن المحاولة.

7.o: يخبر "داي وونغ" "هاي إن" أنّه في الوقت الحاضر عليه البقاء مع "مي هو". وفي تلك الأثناء، تشعر "مي هو" بالأسى على "داي وونغ".

8.o: يذهب "داي وونغ" و"مي هو" إلى السينما، وهناك تشاهد "مي هو" الكثير من العشاق يتعانقون فتحاول أن تفعل الشيء نفسه مع "داي وونغ".

9.o: يطلب جدّ "داي وونغ" منه العودة إلى الديار. ولاحقًا، تشعر "مي هو" بألم مفاجئ، فتكتشف أنّ أحد ذيولها قد اختفى.

10.o: تذهب "مي هو" التي لا تريد الاختفاء عن "داي وونغ" إلى "هي إن" وتخبرها عن الخرزة، وعن مدى رغبتها في البقاء.

11.o: تخطّط "هاي إن" لتُشعِر "مي هو" بالغيرة، وتدرك "مي هو" أنّها يجب أن تتعلّم العيش بدون "داي وونغ".

12.o: يكتشف "داي وونغ" و"مي هو" أخيرًا حقيقة شعورهما حيال بعضهما، وتضع "مي هو" خططًا لما تريد أن تفعله عندما تصبح إنسانة.

13.o: يستمتع "داي وونغ" و"مي هو" بموعد غراميّ طبيعيّ. وفي وقت لاحق، تُخبر "هاي إن" "داي وونغ" أنّ "دونغ جو" و"مي هو" لشيء خطير.

14.o: يخبر "داى وونغ" "مي هو" أنّه من أجل أن يحيا كلاهما، يتعيّن عليهما في اللحظة التي تنقضي فيها نصف مدّة المائة يوم أن يتبادلا القُبل.

15.o: تزور "مي هو" متجر زفاف مع "دونغ جو"، وتخبر "دونغ جو" أن "داي وونغ" سيكون على ما يرام حين يرى أنّها تزوجت من شخص آخر، وتحيا حياة طيّبة.

16.o: يُفاجأ "داي وونغ" عندما يعلم أنّ "مي هو" لم يبقَ لها سوى ذيل واحد فقط، وتخبره أنّها لا تزال راغبةً في أن تصبح إنسانة، وستبقى مع "دونغ جو".

5.o: يبحث كازويا برفقة فيكتوريكا عن الكتاب الذي خبأته أفريل سعيًا لمعرفة سر هذا الكتاب، تصل لاحقًا بعض البلاغات إلى غريفيل عن كوياران ثم يسمع كازويا صراخ شبح المخزن، فيهرع إلى فيكتوريكا ولكنه لا يجدها في أعلى البرج بعد سماع قصة الجنية الذهبية.

6.t: A Gray Wolf Summons its Brethren
6.o: يرافق كازويا رميلته أفريل في جولة في سوق المدينة ويتوقفان عند أحد الباعة، ولكن تحدث سرقة في المكان، لاحقًا يجد كازويا إعلانًا في الصحيفة لمهرجان غريب فيعرضه على فيكتوريكا التي تبدي اهتمامًا مفاجئًا فيه، فيرافقها كازويا لمعرفة السبب.

7.t: An Oracle is Sent Down at the Midsummer Feast
7.ar: الوحي المنزل في مهرجان الانقلاب الصيفي
7.o: تواصل فيكتوريكا محاولاتها في معرفة ما حدث لوالدتها في القرية، ويحاول أشخاص إخراج فيكتوريكا وكازويا من القرية باستخدام بعض الحيل المخيفة، لاحقًا يحتفل أهل القرية بالمهرجان ويموت عدة أشخاص أثناء هذا الاحتفال بطرق غريبة.

8.t: Howling Echoes from the Kingdom of the Past
8.o: تحاول فيكتوريكا حل لغز الضحايا الذين يتساقطون واحدًا تلو الآخر بدءًا من قضية ثيودورو في القرية المعزولة، فتجهز خطة لكشف لغز الحاضر ثم تجهز خطة أخرى لكشف لغز الماضي وكشف الحقيقة الغائبة.

9.t: A Blue Rose Blossoms in a Cannibal Department Store
9.ar: الوردة الزرقاء تتفتح في متجر آكلي لحوم البشر متعدد الأقسام
9.o: يهدي كازويا زي كيمونو لفيكتوريكا حصل عليه من أخته قبل أن يسافر إلى مدينة أخرى للتسوق، ولكن تحدث أمور غريبة في المدينة الأخرى ويطلب مساعدة الشرطة ولكن دون أن يستطيع إثبات أي شيء فتتركه الشرطة وحيدًا ليواجه هذه الأمور الغريبة بمفرده.

10.t: Girl With Cold Dreams of Her Stubborn Friend
10.ar: التي أصيبت بنزلة برد تحلم بصديقها العنيد
10.o: تختطف عربة مارة كازويا ليجد بداخلها معلومة تدين جانتان ولكن دون أي أدلة تثبت حجته، يحاول لاحقًا التعاون مع الشرطة بمساعدة أحد الأطفال للحصول على الأدلة ويطلب من فيكتوريكا مساعدته.

11.t: The Drill Speaks Eloquently of Love
11.o: تزور جاكلين مع مرافقتها ماريون المكتبة للتبرع ببعض الكتب للمكتبة فيتذكر غريفيل ما حدث بينهما في الماضي ويحاول كازويا معرفة تفاصيل أكثر عن طبيعة علاقة غريفيل وجاكلين.

12.t: Listening to the Voice of the Cicadas on a Summer Afternoon
12.ar: الاستماع لأزيار الحصاد في ظهيرة الصيف
12.o: تبدأ عطلة الصيف ويقضي كل طالب العطلة بطريقته إما بالسفر خارجًا أو زيارة الأقارب أو الاستجمام في مكان ما، ولكن تبقى فيكتوريكا عالقة في المدرسة غير قادرة على الخروج منها فيفكر كازويا بما يستطيع فعله.

13.t: He Who is His Own Lawyer Has a Fool for a Client
13.o: يشاهد كازويا وأفريل فلمًا عن الخيميائي ليفاياثان وبعدهما غادرا قاعة السينما تحدثا عن القصة واكتشفا بأنها مقتبسة من إحدى الأماكن الحقيقية، يصادف كازويا لاحقًا رجلًا يحتضر ويخبر فيكتوريكا التي تحاول حل هذا اللغز.

14.t: A Malicious Frill Denounces a Farting Newt
14.ar: المكشكشة سيئة المزاج تلوم السحلية الضارطة
14.o: تجبر المعلمة سيشيل فيكتوريكا على الذهاب للمدرسة بعد تعاونها مع كازويا، لا تتأقلم فيكتوريكا في الفصل وتتشاجر مع أفريل، ثم تحاول فيكتوريكا حل لغز ليفاثايان بمساعدة من كازويا وأفريل واكتشاف علاقة برايان روسكو بالقضية.

15.t: Two Monsters Know Each Others' Hearts
15.o: تستمر محاولات فيكتوريكا في حل اللغز المرتبط بالقصة القديمة ومحاولة اكتشاف الأحداث التي دفنت في الماضي والبحث عن الحقيقة التي أخفاها الأولون وعلاقتها بها.

16.t: The Toppled Maria Has the Head of a Fly
16.ar: القديسة العذراء الساقطة رأسها رأس ذبابة
16.o: أثناء تنزه كازويا مع أفريل يجدان بائع حلوى فيقرر كازويا شراء بعضها لفيكتوريكا، يعود للمكتبة ويبحث عنها ولكنه لا يجدها ليكتشف لاحقًا بأنها لم تعد موجودة ليبدأ البحث عن أدلة تقوده إليها.

17.t: The Box Lies in the Spiral Labyrinth
17.o: يعثر كازويا على فيكتوريكا ويساعدها للخروج، ولكن لا يمكنهما المغادرة حتى انتهاء الاحتفال وتحدث فوضى لاحقًا في المكان فيحاولان النجاة منها.

18.t: The Jet-Black Train Carries Several Lies
18.ar: قطار الفحم الأسود يحمل العديد من الأكاذيب
18.o: كازويا وفيكتوريكا عائدان عبر القطار ولكن يرافقهما بعض ركاب غرباء يلعبون لعبة يتحير منها كازويا، تحاول فيكتوريكا مسايرة هذه اللعبة ولكن تزداد خطورة اللعبة ويحاولان النجاة منها.

19.t: The Rose-Colored Life is Covered in New Snow
19.ar: الثلج المتهاطل حديثًا يدفن الحياة الوردية
19.o: تستذكر كوريديليا ماضيها رفقة برايان وعلاقتها بالماركيز بلوا وكيف التقت به وما علاقة فيكتوريكا بها وكيف آلت بها الآمور لما هي عليه بينما يستعد الماركيز بلوا لاستخدام فيكتوريكا لحل أصعب قضية كما يصفها.

20.ar: شبح فانتوم يرشد إلى طريق الحقيقة
20.o: يريد الماركيز بلوا الحصول على دليل دامغ في قضية كوكو روز لذلك يكلف فيكتوريكا بحل القضية، وحينما علم كازويا بهذا قرر مساعدة فيكتوريكا في جمع أجزاء الفوضى لحل القضية.

21.t: The Christmas Eve Bell Urges on the Hour
21.ar: أجراس الليلة المقدسة تسرع عجلة الزمن
21.o: يبدأ كازويا رفقة فيكتوريكا تحقيقهما بشأن نيكول لولو، فتعيد فيكتوريكا رواية الأحداث أثناء عرض مسرحي محاولةً توضيح كل ما يتعلق بالقضية.

1.o: John Beecham, a handsome ex-soldier of the East India Company, arrives in Delhi in 1800 determined to make a new life for himself, but will the secret he is carrying be revealed?

But, the arrival of the mysterious Chandrika throws the household into chaos and threatens to break the family apart.

3.o: A murder throws John's plans of staying in Delhi into jeopardy, while a member of the household reveals a treacherous side to their nature that proves dangerous. However, John soon finds that he has people around him he can trust when Margaret places herself at great personal risk to help him.

5.o: John is shocked to discover that Margaret has left Delhi, but before he can react there is worse news at home.

6.o: John has spent several days and nights in his cell and has finally worked out who betrayed him. Daniel, Margaret and Chandrika desperately try to help release him, but only the Emperor can let him go free - and this will only happen when he is told a hard truth. Back home, the house is attacked.

1.o: A dangerous new drug is on the streets, and its addicts are causing trouble around town. Takashi enlists Makoto’s aid in dealing with the problem, and for Makoto, things soon become personal.

2.o: There’s a new gang in town, and the word on the street is that they’re acting as enforcers for a local business that treats its employees in highly questionable fashion. It’s up to Makoto and one of said employees to uncover the truth.

3.o: An online content creator asks the G-Boys to provide him with a bodyguard, so Makoto is put on the job. This means he has to learn what video sharing is all about, and that’s just the start of his revealing experience with ongoing online education.

4.o: A man he’s only just met asks Makoto if he can help him figure out who killed his son five years ago. Thus begins some detective work for Makoto, which ends up digging up things that perhaps should have remained buried in the past.

5.o: An advisor for technical intern trainees from China asks Makoto to help him find one of his missing charges. If she isn’t back at her factory in time for an upcoming inspection, it could end up being bad news for everybody.

6.o: Someone called Shadow is going around beating up G-Boys, and all the victims happen to be under Hiroto’s command. Hiroto suspects Takashi is responsible, so Makoto has to figure out who hired Shadow before a war breaks out.

7.o: Information about Shadow and his employer trickles in, as Makoto pulls out all the stops to prevent a civil war amongst the G-Boys. Now the question is, how big are the risks he’s willing to take to maintain peace in Ikebukuro?

8.o: Kyouichi suspects one of his fans is having trouble getting by, so he asks Makoto to go check in on her and her young son. Makoto’s mother takes an unexpected interest in the situation as well, and they find there’s more going on than meets the eye.

9.o: The members of the G-Boys are hired to act as bodyguards to a group that opposes ethnic discrimination that is against an opposing group. However, Makoto gets roped into another job about places run by foreign ethnicities are being harassed.

10.o: A woman abruptly commissions Makoto to get revenge for an attack that crippled her brother. But the "beast" who attacked him hardly seems savage, so Makoto decides to dig a little deeper on this case.

11.o: As tensions rise between the G-Boys and the Red Angels, Makoto finds himself mediating from the middle as usual. But this time the situation is different, and the stakes become much higher than they've ever been.

12.o: Now on the run from most of his former friends, Makoto has to use all the resources he has left to piece together who's causing so much trouble in Ikebukuro. Chances are, it's the same one who seems to have a personal grudge against him.

1.o: Go Won Pyo of the Gyeru Tribe comes before King Pyeongwon and threatens him with his private army for the exclusive rights to salt. Despite the King's unrest, Queen Yeon leaves for patrol taking Princess Pyeonggang with her. Meanwhile, On Hyeop the chief of the Sunno Tribe tests his son's manhood. Part 2: While Queen Yeon visits On Hyeop, Go Won Pyo arrives on King Pyeongwon's decree to kill Queen Yeon and Princess Pyeonggang. Princess Pyeonggang escapes with Dal's help as Oh Hyeop and Queen Yeon confronts Go Won Pyo. Meanwhile, King Pyeongwon looks for Wol Gwang, Queen Yeon's secret lover.

2.o: Eight years go by and although Yeom Ga Jin wants to live a humble, quiet life, she has one last mission to complete, to assassinate King Pyeongwon. On her way to the palace, she saves On Dal's life but does not recognize him, and they go their separate ways. Meanwhile, Go Won Pyo prepares an attack on the King during the farewell ceremony for the late Queen Yeon. On Dal saves Ga Jin and nurses her back to health. While she recuperates, her companions hear about her failed attempt and search for her. When they find her, they remind her of their rule to kill anyone who sees their face or to marr

3.o: Ga Jin rushes back to Cheonjubang after hearing that her father was in trouble due to her failing her mission to assassinate King Pyeongwon. On her return, Du Jung Seo releases her father, Yeom Deuk, but instead holds her captive after she asks about her past. Meanwhile, On Dal hears of Ga Jin's predicament and rushes to save her.

4.o: King Pyeongwon believes he is seeing the ghost of Princess Pyeonggang as she stands in front of him in the flesh. However, Ga Jin escapes with help from Go Geon who she remembers but not without being warned of her fate if she returned as an assassin. Meanwhile, hanging upside down, On Dal waits for her return.

5.t: Go Geon Promises to Bring Back the Princess
5.o: Go Geon reports to King Pyeongwon that Princess Pyeonggang is alive, showing him the jade necklace as proof. He promises to bring her back safely to the palace without his father, Go Won Pyo, knowing about it. Meanwhile, Ga Jin tries to change On Dal's heavy conscience as he turns his back on her.

6.o: On Dal and Ga Jin strike water and bring joy to Ghost Valley. However, despite the happiness, Ga Jin comes face to face with Du Jung Seo who tells her about the twins. She is left to decide whether to save them and break her promise of not killing again. Meanwhile, Go Won Pyo gives three hundred mounted men and three hundred soldiers to Go Geon after seeing King Pyeongwon.

7.o: On Dal gets released from holding and reunites with Pung Gae, Weol, and the Tara twins while Ga Jin returns to being the Princess. Although they all are astonished at her royal descent, On Dal believes she will return to them. Meanwhile, Go Won Pyo meets Hae Mo Young and plots to hurt the Princess.

8.o: Thanks to Geon and Dal’s help, Ga Jin manages to save the women from being sold off to Silla. After returning to the palace, Ga Jin suggests that the King should punish Hae Ji Weol for trying to sell the women as contributes to Silla. Meanwhile, Gochuga tells Geon that he doesn’t have to leave for the borderline.

9.o: The candidates for the royal wedding are called into the palace. However, it is Gochuga’s plan to make Ga Jin and Geon get married. Dal hides his identity and sneaks into the palace, but he gets caught by Geon. The King calls in Ga Jin and demands an explanation about their relationship. Ga Jin lies to the king that they are already married, and the king tells her to leave the palace.

10.o: Ga Jin and Dal come to Ghost Valley to live with Lady Sa. They lie to her that they are now married, hiding the fact that they are there to train Dal in swordsmanship. However, Lady Sa has a hard time accepting the princess as her daughter-in-law. Meanwhile, Geon becomes the Crown Prince’s trainer, but the young prince refuses to leave his chambers.

11.o: Despite Lady Sa’s anger at Dal’s decision to train in swordsmanship, he is determined to become a general like his father. Soon, his skills surpass the level at which Ga Jin can train him. She suggests that Dal go to study with a new master, and the pair set off to find him. Meanwhile, Mo Yong and the chief of Cheonjubang convince Royal Consort Hyeon to do a ritual.

12.t: The Reason to Wield a Sword
12.o: After saving Ga Jin and Lady Sa by killing the men sent by Go Won Pyo, Dal falls into a state of shock. In order to help him find his path again, Ga Jin speaks to Un Am and Lady Sa about General On’s wishes for Dal. Meanwhile, Geon corners Mo Yong with his knowledge of her identity. Then Mo Yong is asked to carry out a dangerous task by Gochuga.

13.o: The Northern Zhou army marches ferociously down south. Bearing his weak body, King Pyeongwon calls upon all tribes to battle. The Sunno Tribe also stands up for war, whereas Gochuga sees this as an opportunity to fulfill his desire. Goguryeo faces a vast danger that will decide the fate of the nation. The only solution is for the five tribes to unite and fight as one.

14.o: Du Jung Seo poisons King Pyeongwon and Crown Prince Won, but Ga Jin and Dal save them just in time. As the King orders the incident never be spoken of, Ga Jin suspects the Queen’s intentions. Meanwhile, the people of Sunno Tribe prepare to move the Pyeongyang Castle, but Lady Sa refuses to go with Dal.

15.o: The Princess succeeds in luring Go Won Pyo and the Queen into her trap. In return for not exposing the two, she demands one thing from each of them. Slowly gaining power within the palace, the Princess falls deeply into the concern of how to deal with the Go Family. However, the Go Family’s response still seems unpredictable.

16.o: Dal volunteers to lead the troops to Hwangju Fortress and subdue the revolt that has broken out. However, when Ga Jin shows up after the fighting has subsided, she and Dal argue about how to proceed from there. Meanwhile, the news of more revolts at other fortresses arrives, and Gochuga bides his time to attack the palace.

17.o: Go Won Pyo and his son are thrown in prison. As they await their punishment, a small moment of peace finds its way to the palace. Meanwhile, Lady Sa takes a journey to the capital to visit Dal for the first time in a while. However, not long after her visit, Tara Jin comes by with news of an attack against the palace. Pyeonggang and Dal prepare for battle and whatever fate may come.

18.o: It is now four years after Gochuga’s death, and Crown Prince Won sits on the throne of Goguryeo. Pyeonggang fights war after war to help the young king, but her brother seems to misunderstand her intentions. Meanwhile, Dal lives like a hermit in the woods, and Geon lives as a drunkard in Silla. However, he suddenly decides to return to Goguryeo.

19.o: Go Geon comes back to Goguryeo as an envoy of Silla. As the palace of Pyeongyang is in a state of unrest with his presence, King Yeongyang thinks deeply of what to do with him. Meanwhile, On Dal lives lonely in the mountains until he hears some unexpected news. Not knowing the true intentions that Go Geon holds, the tension within Pyeongyang palace thickens.

20.t: The Battle at Adan Fortress Continues
20.o: King Yeongyang decides to send reinforcements to Adan Fortress where Pyeonggang and Dal fight to defend it. Dal commands Pyeonggang and Jin to take the wounded back to Pyeongyang Castle, but Pyeonggang has plans of her own. As he awaits the Silla army to attack, Dal receives a letter from King Jinheung instead.

1.o: مع وصول "إيفا"، ينصت زملاؤها في الفصل - وخصوصًا "كاميلو" - إلى تعاليمها وتأملاتها، لكن لا يتمتع الجميع بنفس الدفء وسعة الصدر.

2.o: يتحرّى الفتيان عن "إيفا" بعد أن ساورهم الشكّ في تصرفاتها إلى درجة يصعب تصديقها، فينتهي بهم المطاف في وضع فاضح. وتخوض المجموعة تجربة مصيرية للمرّة الأولى.

3.t: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
3.o: عندما يسمع الشبان عن احتمال ترك "إيفا" للمدرسة، يجتمعون ويضعون خطة لمساعدتها على البقاء... مما يمهد الطريق لمشهد صادم في نهاية المطاف.

4.o: تترك "إيفا" انطباعًا قويًّا لدى والدي "كاميلو"، ويؤدي مشروع المجموعة السرّي إلى فصل "كاميلو" و"إيفا"، بينما يتلقى "بابون" خبرًا مفجعًا.

5.o: مع تصادم عالمي "إستيلا" والسيد "بابون"، يتعين على "كاميلو" و"إيفا" البحث بشكل أعمق لمعرفة الحقيقة... في خضم الكثير من الاتهامات والنزاعات.

6.o: تتعمق شكوك "كاميلو" بشأن ما ترويه "إيفا"، ويعرض أن يساعدها في تحسين درجاتها، لكنها تملك خططًا أخرى... ما يشعره بطعنة خنجر في قلبه.

7.o: بعد قضاء سهرة شراب، تبوح "إيفا" بتفاصيل شديدة الخصوصية عن حياتها، وهو ما يدفع "كاميلو" إلى أن يطلب من "أربيلايز" مراقبة تصرّفاتها عن قرب.

8.o: تثير احتجاجات قائمة في الشوارع التوتّر بين أفراد المجموعة وداخل منزل "كاميلو"، الذي ينفّذ خطة ماكرة ليزرع الغيرة في قلب "إيفا".

9.o: يجد "كاميلو" نفسه في موقف صعب، لكنه يتيح له أخيرًا التعبير عن مشاعره... غير أنّ هناك مشكلة واحدة تتمثّل في الشخص المتلقّي للإعجاب.

10.o: تأتي "إيفا" لنجدة "كاميلو"، ويلومها "مارتين" على نزاعها المتواصل مع المجموعة. وفي حفل تخرج فيه الأمور عن مسارها، يحظى "كاميلو" بفرصة جديدة.

11.o: تبوء خطة والد "كاميلو" لأخذه إلى قسّ بالفشل، ويفصح "مارتين" عن مكنون قلبه كما لم يسبق له من قبل، فيما تودّع المجموعة صديقًا عزيزًا.

12.o: تستمتع "إيفا" و"كاميلو" بالتورط في المتاعب، ويُبدي "كاميلو" استعداده لحماية "إيفا" بأيّ ثمن، فيجد أخيرًا طريقه إلى قلبها.

13.o: بينما يخوض والداه مرحلة صعبة في علاقتهما، يستمتع "كاميلو" بأجمل أيام حياته مع "إيفا"... ولكن، هل سينجو حبّهما من المستقبل القاتم؟

1.o: يشعر "كاميلو" بفرحة ممزوجة بالألم بشأن عودة "إيفا"، بينما يدفع هروب "لويسا" من المدرسة الداخلية الجميع إلى الاصطدام بالواقع ومواجهة حقيقة قاسية. ويساور "سالسيدو" و"كاسترو" الشك.

2.o: تأتي افتراضات خاطئة في صالح "كاميلو" لكن ذلك لن يدوم طويلًا. ويشعل تغيير "لويسا" رأيها شرارة تصرف متمرد متقن وماكر، ويواجه زواج "آنا" و"خوسيه" بعض المشاكل.

3.t: Letters to a Child Never Born
3.ar: رسائل إلى طفل لم يولد قط
3.o: يتكاتف الطلاب لتحقيق العدالة باستثناء "سالسيدو"، بينما يسفر اجتماع أولياء الأمور والمعلمين عن نقاش محتدم ونتيجة محبطة. وتخطر على بال "إيفا" فكرة ماكرة.

4.o: تمتزج مشاعر الحزن والفرح في عطلة المجموعة، لكن المفاجأة الكبرى تنتظر أفرادها في "بوكارامانغا". ولا تزال "آنا" ترغب في البقاء بمفردها، الأمر الذي يثير استياء "خوسيه".

5.o: بعد وصول منتظر إلى "كارتاخينا" يحمل وعودًا وآمالًا، تتحطم أحلام "كاميلو" في الحب والعمل... لكنه ليس الوحيد الذي يواجه مشاعر غير متبادلة.

6.o: يسعى "كاميلو" جاهدًا لكسب ود "إيفا"، لكن شابًّا جديدًا مثيرًا للاهتمام يعقّد الأمور أمامه. وبينما تعيش "لويسا" حالة صراع داخلي، تجد السلوان برفقة شخص غير متوقع.

7.t: Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands
7.o: يبدأ "كاميلو" في مصادقة "ألفريدو" والانسجام معه، إلى أن يكشف عن نواياه الحقيقية. وتساهم المعلمة الجديدة في توسيع آفاق بعضهم، وتثير ذكريات من الماضي لآخرين.

8.o: تدفع تجربة تحت تأثير الهلوسة "إيفا" إلى فتح قلبها لـ"كاميلو" الذي يتساءل عن دوره في حياتها، وتبوح "روساريو" بأخبار صادمة تخطف أنفاس الجميع... ولا سيما "خوسيه".

9.t: The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State
9.o: يشارك "كاميلو" الأمر الذي اكتشفه مع المجموعة. وفي وقت لاحق، يذهب هو و"إيفا" إلى منزل "روساريو" بينما يعود "خوسيه" إلى البيت مرة أخرى.

10.o: في ظل تأهب "إيفا" لتأسيس مجلس طلابي وبداية حلول التغييرات، يتساءل "كاميلو" عمّا إذا كانت النهايات الجلية ليست سوى بدايات جديدة.

1.o: In 1959, after a group of nine student hikers are found dead in the Ural Mountains, KGB Major Oleg Kostin is sent to investigate. During the autopsy, Oleg has a flashback of a disturbing memory from WWII.

2.o: Nine days before the group's death, the hikers pass through a small village where they learn about the region's Indigenous Mansi people, who have named the mountain they're headed toward the Dead Mountain.

3.o: Oleg heads to Moscow to look further into the file of Alexander Zolotarev, the oldest member of the group, and makes a surprising discovery about his body.

4.o: As the hikers prepare for ascension, an ominous wind engulfs them, followed by an astonishing sight in the sky; perplexed, the group begins to remember the words of the Mansi locals before receiving one more warning.

5.o: Tempalov and the searchers examine the scene of the group's death, finding multiple confounding details that inspire different theories; Kostin shows his superiors a report that details strange objects in the sky, and a crucial discovery is made.

6.o: The hikers search for a strange figure in the woods and take him back to camp; Zolotarev is suspicious of the new guy.

7.o: Kostin attempts get to closer the Dyatlov's case. He learns about the prison fugitives and attempts to find out whether this encounter was fatal for the tourists. Kostin decides to confess his feelings to Katya.

8.o: The group reaches the pass and sets up camp. As the night progresses, the conditions worsen and their struggle becomes unthinkable. Each harrowing detail fills in the puzzle pieces of what really happened to the Dyatlov hikers.

1.o: In open ocean off the remote north-west coast of Australia, a deep-water location teeming with marine wildlife has captured the Shipwreck Hunters’ imagination. Obsessed by the potential of finding a historic wreck site, their focus turns to the story of sailors lost at sea and the families they left behind. It’s an adventure full of surprises that will change their lives forever.

2.o: The Shipwreck Hunters search for a luxurious passenger liner named Koombana, which steamed straight into the path of a deadly cyclone off the remote north-west coast of Australia and was never seen again. More than 150 people were lost at sea and communities were left devastated. The team are determined to help solve this epic ocean mystery.

3.o: A surprise attack during World War II in the remote north-west Australian town of Broome destroyed and sank fifteen flying boats, of which five have never been found. The Shipwreck Hunters search this challenging location with some of the biggest tidal variations in the world— as well as sharks, crocodiles and near zero visibility underwater pushing them to their limits.

4.o: The Shipwreck Hunters investigate an epic tale from the age of pirates. Their destination is a wild open-ocean location 130 kilometers off the mainland of Australia’s treacherous north-west coast. The team search an imposing site for clues and explore uninhabited islands nearby to try to put an epic shipwreck story, finally, to rest.

5.o: The Shipwreck Hunters explore the spectacular Ningaloo coast following an incredible 150-year-old story of tragedy and survival. They travel to the far reaches of the largest fringing reef on the planet in search of lost pieces of a shipwreck puzzle, braving extreme ocean currents and reliving a harrowing castaway ordeal.

6.o: The Shipwreck Hunters join maritime archaeologists from the Western Australian Museum to reinvestigate a known shipwreck site and the theory of a second ship lost at the same site in the spectacular Abrolhos Islands. The treacherous location is a hotspot for shipwrecks and mind-blowing ocean biodiversity.

1.o: Paul Beban tries to bring the truth about sea monsters to the surface; after exposing a US Navy encounter with an unclassified creature in a Caribbean trench, Paul tracks a similar one said to be hiding in the dark depths of Vermont's Lake Champlain.

2.o: Paul Beban investigates evil shapeshifters from Navajo folklore known as skinwalkers. Paul tracks the mythical beasts from the heart of Navajo Nation to the infamous Skinwalker Ranch in Utah to Wisconsin, where he captures something unexplainable.

3.o: Visiting a remote Nebraska farm to examine a 60-year-old string of unsolved cattle mutilations across the U.S.; apparent evidence of government cover-ups and connections to UFOs.

4.o: Paul Beban searches for evidence that extraterrestrials are among us. After investigating an alarming abduction case in Massachusetts, Paul unearths long-buried files that could lead to an alien cover-up all the way to the White House.

5.o: Paul Beban treks deep into the woods of the Midwest looking for Bigfoot. He cuts through hoaxes, pranks and misinformation in search of groundbreaking evidence to prove the mysterious creature's existence once and for all.

1.o: When Talib is discovered killed in his apartment, Detective Mustafa arrives at the crime scene, riddled with conflicting forensic evidence and baffling puzzles.

2.o: Afaf shares a crucial piece of information with Mustafa. Soon enough, suspicion shifts towards Rasha.

3.o: Mansoor sees Rasha's misfortune as a golden opportunity to showcase his skills as a lawyer, while Sajee' takes advantage of her vulnerability to pursue his own agenda.

4.o: When Mustafa returns to Talib's apartment, the “man with the limp” emerges as the prime suspect. Soon after, Mustafa is forced to put his friendship with Mansoor on the line and stick to the duties of his job.

5.o: Sajee' presents Rasha with an offer. Afaf becomes a new enigma in the case. Aktham discreetly disposes of some incriminating belongings.

6.o: Mustafa delves into the mystery linking Afaf and Taleb's murders. After rejecting Sajee', Rasha faces her most humiliating moment yet.

7.o: Sajee’ shows up at Aktham’s doorstep to try turning him against Rasha. Khalil’s misfortune becomes another golden opportunity for Mansoor.

8.o: Mustafa is determined to confront Sajee’, no matter the cost. Khalil finds himself forced to expose the identity of the other woman in his life.

9.o: Mansoor is asked to defend yet another suspect. After enduring so much pain, Sajee’ is determined to settle the score.

10.o: SEASON FINALE: As Mansoor and Mustafa get closer to unmasking "the clown", they stand face-to-face with the grand finale of the show…

1.o: In order to ask Daji to be the Female Lead of his graduation short film, Zhou Shui took Daji to an Internet cafe to watch the student work he had filmed.

2.o: Daji went to Beijing and lived in poverty. Zhou Shui learned about Daji's living conditions and secretly rushed to Beijing, determined to help Daji through the difficulties.

3.o: On New Year's Eve, Zhou Shui and Daji finally fell in love and decided to stay in Beijing together.

4.o: Zhou Shui edited the video he shot after meeting Daji into a documentary, and Daji was deeply moved after watching it.

5.o: Daji becomes an intern in the programme crew as she wished, and she works very hard. However, the team loses an expensive necklace, and Daji runs into trouble.

6.o: Daji had severe abdominal pain and Zhou Shui took her to the hospital. The doctor told Zhou Shui that Daji was suspected of having gallbladder cancer.

7.o: Zhou Shui took Daji to visit another doctor and found out that the previous diagnosis was a mistake. After experiencing the desperate situation of almost losing Daji, Zhou Shui's thoughts changed.

8.o: Zhou Shui confessed the truth about his failed investment. Based on the principle that "loyalty is the most important thing in a relationship", Daji decided to find a job for Zhou Shui.

9.o: In order to arrange a job vacancy for Zhou Shui, Yang Yiming asked Daji to send him money used to build relationships. Daji came to Yang Yiming's home alone late at night, but Yang Yiming tried to assault her.

10.o: Daji resigned, and she had no reason stay in Beijing. Zhou Shui didn't want to lose Daji, so he asked Daji to meet in Sanlitun, intending to make a final effort to save their love.

11.o: After a period of thinking, Zhou Shui just wanted to live a peaceful life with Daji, but Daji felt exhausted and hoped to end the relationship.

12.o: Members of the share house left Beijing one after another, leaving Zhou Shui alone, but he didn't know where to go.

13.o: Daji couldn't help but questioned Zhou Shui's purpose. Zhou Shui replied that he wanted to take Daji back to Beijing to live a new life and continue to pursue their dreams.

14.o: Zhou Shui and Daji entered a production company and started to prepare shooting of a promotional video. They brought along editor Xiao Mao and photographer Xue Cheng to form a team and work together.

15.o: The company was going to hold a Creative Ideas competition, and the winner would have the opportunity to become a full-time employee and make movies. Zhou Shui and Daji's team decided to give it a try.

16.o:
Zhaoyang invited Zhou Shui and Daji to start a business together and promised to give them a chance to make movies. Zhou Shui successfully shot his

first commercial at Zhaoyang's Company.

17.o: On Valentine's Day, Zhou Shui prepared a computer as a present. He carefully edited videos recording their precious memories and stored in the computer.

18.o: Daji's mother came to Beijing to visit her daughter. After seeing Dal's current living conditions, she felt that Daji was suffering with Zhou Shui.

19.o: Daji's mother was sick, but she asked Daji not to tell Zhou Shui because she worried that Zhou Shui's family would Look down upon Daji.

20.t: Going Through Ups and Downs Together
20.o: Zhou Shui planned to start a business, determined to make money and bring Daji back to Beijing city area to live a better life.

21.o: In 2016, Zhou Shui and Daji's company was doing very well, but their relationship gradually changed from a couple to business partners.

22.o: Daji didn't want a marriage without passion. She convinced Zhou Shui to pursue their dream to make a movie.

23.o: Producer Ms. Chao arbitrarily amended the script, and Zhou Shui was furious. Daji suggested giving up the opportunity to make movie and return to Beijing to start a new life.

24.o: In 2017, Zhou Shui and Daji broke up. Daji returned to Beijing alone and accidentally lost the computer containing their memories at the airport.

25.o: Zhou Shui went to Daji's hometown and found that Daji had moved away. He could no longer save their love.

26.o: In 2025, Zhou Shui and Daji finally met again in the conference room. The people in the room did not know their relationship, so the two pretended to be strangers.

1.o: حين تختفي مربية إحدى الجارات بعد طلبها التحدث معها، تشعر "سيسيلي" بالمسؤولية... الأمر الذي يدفعها على التحقيق في القضية شخصيًا.

2.o: تساور "سيسيلي" الشكوك حول "راسموس" بعد العثور على أدلة محتملة، فيما تغرق ضابطة الشرطة "آيشا" في قضية اختفاء "روبي" بعد تعيينها للتحقيق فيها.

3.o: تُخبر "سيسيلي" "آيشا" عما اكتشفته حول القضية، يضغط أصدقاء "فيغو" عليه لمشاركة مقاطع فيديو غير لائقة في دردشتهم الجماعية.

4.o: يؤدي توقف في التحقيق بـ"آيشا" للظن بما هو أسوأ، فيما تساور الشكوك "سيسيلي" حول "مايك" بعد العثور على معلومات مشكوك فيها على هاتفه.

5.o: بينما تطلب "كاتارينا" من "سيسيلي" أن تساعدها في أمر يفطر القلب، تتلقى "آيشا" أوامر بإغلاق ملف القضية وهو ما يحفزها على سبر أغوار الحقيقة الخفية.

6.o: فيما يحاول المحيطون بها تحريف القصة لصالحهم، تساور "سيسيلي" الشكوك والتساؤلات حول حقيقة الأشخاص الذين تتعامل معهم.

1.o: ينتشر مقلب على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي سريعًا في ساعات متأخرة من الليل، فيطلق تفاعلًا تسلسليًّا استثنائيًّا يقود إلى قاعدة قوات جوية بالغة السرّية في "نيفادا".

2.t: They Can't Stop All of Us
2.o: بينما ينطلق حدث "عاصفة المنطقة 51"، يجد "ماتي" عملاء من مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي يطرقون بابه. ومع عدم جاهزيتهم للتعامل مع الهجوم، يعدّ أهل الصحراء أنفسهم لاستقبال الكارثة.

1.o: تعود "أنا"، مذيعة أخبار التلفزيون، إلى بلدتها الصغيرة بولاية "جورجيا" لإجراء تغطية صحفية لجريمة قتل وتكتشف أن زوجها "جاك" الذي انقطعت علاقتها به هو المحقق الرئيسي المكلف بالقضية.

2.o: يحاول "جاك" و"بريا" كشف الثغرات في ذريعة غياب المشتبه به الرئيسي. أمّا "أنا"، فتقرر زيارة مدرستها لإجراء مقابلة مشحونة بالتوتر مع زميلة دراسة قديمة.

3.o: تغتنم "أنا" الفرصة للعودة إلى مكتب تقديم الأخبار، وتواجه "زوي" "جاك" بشأن ما يخفيه، فيما يفرض تدهور حالة "أليس" خوض بعض النقاشات المؤلمة.

4.o: يواجه "جاك" صعوبة في تهدئة سكان البلدة خلال اجتماع مجلس البلدية العاصف، وتبلغ شكوك "بريا" ذروتها، فيما تعيش "أنا" صراعًا مع ذكرياتها المؤلمة.

5.o: يصبح "جاك" أكثر اضطرابًا مع تزايد الضغوط عليه. وتجد "أنا" نفسها تخضع للاستجواب خلال مقابلة ما، فيما ينكشف ماضي "ريتشارد".

6.o: مع اقتراب القضية من نهايتها، يواجه "جاك" و"أنا" خطايا الماضي... والتداعيات القاسية التي يفرضها الحاضر.

1.o: عندما يعجب الأستاذ الجامعي "مون أوه هيو" بموهبة طالبه "كانغ لي" المذهلة، يعرض عليه دروسًا خاصة في الكتابة... إلى جانب طلب مقلق يتجاوز حدوده الأخلاقية.

2.o: تبدأ قصة "كانغ" بلقاء عابر مع زميله في الصف "سي يون كيم". وبينما تساور "مون أوه" الشكوك حول نوايا "كانغ"، يقع حادث مفاجئ يكشف عن حقيقة صادمة.

3.o: يزداد هوس "مون أوه" بأحداث القصة وما يتكشف بين طيّاتها، فيما تشير أصابع الاتهام إلى والد "سي يون". وعلى صعيد آخر، يواصل "كانغ" بحثه المحموم مما يقوده إلى ملاحقة شخص ما.

4.o: تتزايد الشكوك مع استمرار "كانغ" في تحرّكاته ومراقبته، بينما يتردد "مون أوه" في منعه من الكتابة. وفي وقت لاحق، تصل رسالة تدفع "كانغ" للذهاب ليلًا إلى لقاء ما.

5.o: عندما تنتهي قصة "كانغ" بنهاية مثيرة، يترقب "مون أوه" بقلق بالغ ما سيكتبه بعد ذلك. وتضطرّ والدة "سي يون" لاتخاذ قرار متهور لحماية عائلتها.

6.o: يتملّك "مون أوه" الهوس حول كتابات "كانغ"، بينما يواصل الأخير تجاوز الحدود في سبيل موهبته... ما يدفع بكليهما نحو حافة الهاوية.
